method: Direct rendered UI observations and pointer interactions in the official free DMO demo. These files are reference evidence only; no runtime path loads them.

spinSampling.note: HOLD input and remote observation latency can cover more than one demo round. The five images are distinct observed result states, not a verified one-to-one server round sequence. The original fifth immediate image still showed STOP; spin-05-settled.jpg was captured after it returned idle.

observed: Original five-by-three symbol grid, central selected 1x through 5x wheel sector, and original control artwork were visible.
BET opened choices 0.20, 0.40, 0.60, 0.80 and 1.00 DMO. Selecting 0.40 updated the visible stake.

At 0.40 DMO a 4x result showed total WIN 1.60 and line14 with four plum miniatures and base0.20 multiplied to0.80. A later image18 seconds later retained the same result and caption with a different flame/highlight phase. The exact line-cycle frequency was not measured.
The full payline extended through all five columns while winning borders were limited to matching symbols. The line equation occupied the strip below the reels; total WIN sat between BALANCE and BET.
TAKE WIN cleared the win controls, line caption and wheel flames. The displayed DMO balance changed from19996.40 to19998.00 for the1.60 win.
MENU exposed a paytable and rules, settings for effects/music/fullscreen, and a history tab. The visible rules state20 lines, 1x through5x multipliers, max1000x and RTP96.63%.

AUTO offered25,50,100,500,1000 spins plus win/balance stop limits. After25 was selected and started,24 appeared in the large gold STOP circle; the small AUTO control became a red stop square. Clicking the small stop returned the game to HOLD & SPIN after the accepted round.
QUICK showed an enable/decline dialog. Enabling it changed the spin arrows and lightning icon to yellow.
The bottom SOUND control changed its mute state directly without opening a dialog. Independent sound-effects and music switches were available in settings.
limitations: No provider client scripts, network protocol or hidden RNG parameters were extracted.
Five observations do not establish outcome probabilities, reel weights or exact timing.
Sound UI transitions were observed; no fresh audio recording or claim of audible parity is made.
An earlier attempted STOP click raced a changing button; it is not used as proof of exact STOP timing.
The independent ETB model, existing authenticated wallet and idempotency receipts remain the only ZPLAY payout authority. DMO balances are never copied.
